relationships.subject: K2 cannabidiol-rich C. sativa oil
relationships.evidence_quote: Oral administration of K2 (25 mg kg-1 ) induced a rapid and long-lasting relief of pain hypersensitivity in a mice model of peripheral neuropathy.

relationships.subject: K2 cannabidiol-rich C. sativa oil
relationships.evidence_quote: K2 reduced microglia pro-inflammatory phenotype through the downregulation of histone deacetylase 1 (HDAC-1)

relationships.subject: AM630
relationships.evidence_quote: These effects were reverted by the administration of a CB2 antagonist (AM630), but not by a CB1 antagonist (AM251).

key_findings: Oral CBD-rich terpene-rich oil K2 relieved neuropathic hypersensitivity and reduced spinal MAPKs and neuroinflammation in a CB2-dependent manner
In BV2 microglia K2 lowered HDAC-1 and IKBa and raised IL-10
